theme: The Incentive Trip That Flipped a Sales Team

linkedin.text:
A VP of Sales called me after two missed quarters.

Her ask wasn't vague — she needed her team to remember why they joined the company.

Here's what we built together:
→ 4-day incentive trip, one of our 130+ destinations
→ Morning: structured team challenges with clear stakes
→ Afternoon: genuine downtime — no agenda, no slides
→ Night 3: gala dinner with individual recognition
→ Day 4: a facilitated session to channel the energy forward

Three months later she sent a note: pipeline up, zero voluntary attrition, and her manager was already asking about next year.

Incentive travel works when it's engineered, not assembled.

16 years. 1,500+ events. 25,000+ participants. We've learned the difference.

If you're planning an incentive programme and want to see how we scope these — send me a DM. Happy to share the framework.

That's what 16 years and 1,500+ events teaches you — the ROI of a great incentive trip isn't felt at the airport. It's felt in the next board meeting.
